title: GROUP TOUR TO MACHU PICCHU & TITICACA LAKE SEPTEMBER 2026
description:
Join an exclusive, small group adventure designed for those seeking a personalized and fully accessible experience! ♿🤝 This all-inclusive journey covers everything—from domestic flights and adapted trains to all entrance fees and specialized assistance. Discover the ancient heart of Cusco, the majesty of Machu Picchu, and the serene beauty of Lake Titicaca 🌊 with the confidence of our 10+ years of expertise. We handle every detail, providing barrier-free logistics and high-end support so you can focus on the magic of the Andes. Explore Peru with everything taken care of and no limits! 🌟

Accessible Travel Peru 🇵🇪 - Making Peru Accessible for Everyone ♿ WhatsApp us... click here!

itinerary.title: Arrival in Lima – Welcome to Peru 🇵🇪✈️🤗
itinerary.description:
Upon your arrival at Lima International Airport, our team will be waiting to greet you with a warm welcome and provide comfortable, accessible transportation to your hotel in the city 🛬🚐.

Once settled in, you'll have some time to rest after your journey. Later, we'll meet for a briefing session at the hotel, where we'll go over the details of your adventure, answer any questions, and share helpful tips for the days ahead 📋🗺️.

You'll also receive any mobility equipment or support devices arranged for your trip, ensuring everything is ready for a safe and enriching experience.

♿ From the moment you land, we are here to support you with personalized, accessible service every step of the way.

Welcome to Peru—your unforgettable journey begins now! 💛🌎✨

itinerary.title: Lima City Tour – Contrasts of the City of Kings 🏙️🌊🏛️
itinerary.description:
Start your Peruvian adventure with a fascinating tour of Lima, the vibrant capital known as the City of Kings.

Begin in the elegant coastal district of Miraflores, where you'll enjoy scenic ocean views 🌊 and a panoramic stop at Huaca Pucllana 🏺, an ancient adobe pyramid that speaks to the city's pre-Columbian past.

Then, journey into the heart of the Historic Center of Lima, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Admire the colonial balconies, grand architecture, and charming plazas 🕍. Visit the beautiful Convent of Santo Domingo, home to centuries of spiritual and cultural history.

🍽️ A delicious lunch at a local restaurant is included, featuring a taste of Peru's world-famous cuisine.

♿ The tour is fully accessible, with adapted transportation and dedicated assistance to ensure comfort and inclusion at every stop.

A day filled with history, flavor, and unforgettable first impressions of Peru. 🇵🇪✨

itinerary.title: Flight to Cusco & Afternoon City Tour – Inca Capital Awaits ✈️🏛️🦙
itinerary.description:
This morning, we'll transfer you to Lima Airport for your flight to Cusco, the historic capital of the Inca Empire nestled in the heart of the Andes ⛰️. Upon arrival, our team will warmly welcome you and transfer you to your hotel for a brief rest and acclimatization.

In the afternoon, begin your City Tour of Cusco, a journey through time and tradition. Visit the sacred Qoricancha 🌞, the Inca Temple of the Sun, and walk through the iconic Plaza de Armas 💒, surrounded by colonial charm and lively culture.

Then, explore the awe-inspiring fortress of Sacsayhuamán 🏰, followed by visits to Tambomachay 💧 and panoramic stops at Qenko and Puka Pukará, where the spirit of the Andes still lingers in every stone.

♿ Accessible transportation and personal support are provided to ensure your comfort throughout the day.

A magical first glimpse into Cusco's living history and timeless majesty. 💛✨

itinerary.title: Sacred Valley Full Day – Pisac, Urubamba & Ollantaytambo 🏞️🛕🌽
itinerary.description:
Today you'll explore the breathtaking Sacred Valley of the Incas, a place where history, culture, and nature come together in perfect harmony.

Start your day in Pisac, wandering through its colorful artisan market 🧺 and admiring the terraced hillsides of its ancient ruins.

Continue to Urubamba, where you'll enjoy a delicious buffet lunch 🍽️ featuring local Andean flavors.

In the afternoon, visit the impressive fortress of Ollantaytambo, a living Inca town filled with stories carved in stone 🪨.

This day offers not only incredible views but also a deep connection with the spirit of the Andes 🌄.

♿ Accessible transportation and personal assistance are included to ensure a smooth and enriching experience for all.

A day full of culture, flavors, and awe-inspiring beauty—straight from the heart of the Andes. 💛✨

itinerary.title: Living Culture in Cuper Bajo, Chinchero 🧶🌿🏔️
itinerary.description:
This morning, immerse yourself in the daily life of the Cuper Bajo community, located on the peaceful shores of Lake Piuray, high in the Andes of Chinchero.

Be welcomed by local families and experience authentic Andean living culture through an enriching and hands-on exchange. Discover the ancient art of textile weaving 🧶—from shearing and spinning wool to learning how they create vibrant colors using natural dyes from native plants, minerals, and insects 🌺🌿.

You'll also explore their agricultural traditions, learning about the native crops they grow—such as potatoes, corn, and quinoa 🌽🥔—and the deep connection they maintain with Pachamama (Mother Earth).

🍽️ The experience includes a delicious traditional Pachamanca lunch, where meats and vegetables are slow-cooked underground with hot stones—a true celebration of Andean flavors and community.

♿ This activity is designed to be accessible and inclusive, with adapted support to ensure comfort and full participation for every traveler.

A morning of culture, nature, and connection—shared with the warm hearts of the Andes. 💛🔥✨

itinerary.title: Machu Picchu Full Day Tour 🏞️ | From Cusco & Back
itinerary.description:
Today, you'll embark on a full-day adventure to the majestic citadel of Machu Picchu. Early in the morning, we'll transfer you from your hotel to the train station for a scenic journey through the Sacred Valley. Upon arrival in Aguas Calientes, you'll take a short bus ride up the mountain to reach the entrance of Machu Picchu.

Enjoy a guided tour of this iconic Inca sanctuary, adapted to your pace and needs, with plenty of time to take in the breathtaking views and history.

After exploring the site, return to Aguas Calientes for a delicious lunch at a local restaurant before heading back to Cusco by train and private transfer.

♿ Accessible assistance provided throughout the day for a smooth and enriching experience.

itinerary.title: Titicaca Express - Luxury Train to Puno 🚃
itinerary.description:
Today, we travel from Cusco to Puno aboard the exclusive Titicaca Express, a luxury train journey through the heart of the Andes. While the train is not natively accessible, our specialized team takes full charge of the logistics, providing the necessary equipment and assistance to adapt the experience and ensure your total comfort ♿💪. As we cross the breathtaking high plains, you'll enjoy a world-class all-inclusive service on board, including a gourmet brunch, a multi-course lunch, and a refined afternoon tea 🥗🥂. The trip is a sensory feast with live folkloric shows, an open bar, and a panoramic observation car to witness the stunning highland landscapes 🎶🏔️. We will arrive in Puno around 6:00 PM, where our team will ensure a smooth transfer to your hotel. An unforgettable day of luxury without limits! 🌟✨

PM. Arrive in Puno by evening and settle into your hotel to rest and prepare for your Lake Titicaca adventure.

itinerary.title: Lake Titicaca – Uros & Taquile Islands 🚤🌊
itinerary.description:
Explore the magic of Lake Titicaca on a full-day boat tour to the floating Uros Islands and the traditional island of Taquile.

Start your day navigating the highest navigable lake in the world as you visit the unique Uros community, where locals live on handmade reed islands. Then continue to Taquile, known for its rich textile traditions and stunning lake views.

🍽️ Enjoy a freshly prepared lunch on Taquile Island, featuring local ingredients and Andean hospitality.

♿ The tour includes adapted assistance and personalized support to ensure a safe and inclusive experience on the water and the islands.

Return to Puno in the late afternoon with unforgettable memories of Peru's living lake cultures.

itinerary.title: Puno to Lima ✈️
itinerary.description: Today, we bid farewell to the altiplano. We will enjoy a comfortable 1-hour private transfer from Puno to the Juliaca airport, fully assisted by our team to ensure a seamless boarding process ♿💼. Upon your arrival in Lima, our staff will be waiting to provide a private, accessible transfer to your hotel. After the high-altitude adventures of Cusco and Puno, today is dedicated to your comfort and relaxation. Settle into your room, enjoy the coastal breeze, and take the afternoon to rest and reflect on the incredible journey through the heart of the Andes. A smooth and worry-free transition back to the City of Kings! 🌟🏨

itinerary.title: Time to say good bye...😢
itinerary.description:
After 10 incredible days discovering the soul of Peru—its colors 🎨, flavors 🍲, landscapes 🏔️, and people 🤝—it's time to say goodbye, but not farewell forever.

This morning, we'll accompany you to Lima Airport 🛫, where you'll board your flight back home 🌍.

As your adventure ends, we hope your heart is full ❤️ of unforgettable moments, meaningful connections, and a deep bond with this magical land 🇵🇪.

Thank you for letting us be part of your journey. It has been a true honor to travel with you 🙏.

We'll be waiting with open arms whenever you return 🤗
And like the Inca's says... TUPAYANCHIS K'AMA! - Until life meet us again… ¡Hasta pronto! ✨
